page.overview:
Who is Krang's Android?

An android body built by and equipped with weaponry.

Krang's Android is an Epic Outfit in Fortnite, that can be purchased in the Item Shop with the Krang's Android Bundle for 1,600 V-Bucks or with the Turtles Foes Bundle for 3,200 V-Bucks. Krang's Android was first released in Chapter 6: Season 2 and is part of the .
